title: Beef, barley and Brussels sprout pot

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is a whole ingredient or a plain staple such as beef stock, tomato purée and pearl barley, with no jars, packet mixes or processed substitutes.

supermarket.reason: Beef mince, pearl barley, sprouts, carrots and stock are all everyday Tesco items at ordinary prices.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a lidded casserole, a knife and a wooden spoon, and uses simple browning and simmering.

works.reason: 400g mince, 250g barley and 1.2 litres of stock make a sensible pot for four, and the barley gets about 40 minutes in total, enough to cook it through, while the sprouts go in late so they don't overcook.

honest_times.reason: Twenty-five minutes hands-on fits the chopping, sprout trimming and browning, and 60 minutes total is only slightly tight against the cooking times in the steps.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient is used under its true name, and the only unlisted item is an optional splash of water from the store cupboard.

seasonal_feel.reason: A warming beef and barley pot suits early November, and the 400g of Brussels sprouts is a main component of the dish, not a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are clear, timed and in plain British English, with visual cues a beginner can follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: It is a filling family meal of beef, wholegrain barley and plenty of vegetables.
